title: Controlled Implementation Rules
purpose: Keep implementation work scoped, traceable, conservative, and maintainable.

rules.statement: Before changing anything, confirm or assign the active requirement ID using the configured prefix.
State the minimum access scope before inspecting files.
Inspect only files, modules, components, functions, classes, tables, routes, tests, configurations, or documentation directly required for the active task.
Do not scan the entire repository unless the task cannot be completed safely without broader context.
If additional access becomes necessary, state what additional area is needed and why before expanding scope.
Make the smallest safe maintainable change that satisfies the active requirement.
Preserve existing working behavior unless it conflicts with the active requirement.
Do not modify unrelated files, deployment scripts, build scripts, automation, infrastructure, generated dependency folders, secrets, credentials, or local environment files.
Do not introduce dependencies, schema changes, destructive data changes, or public interface changes unless the active requirement explicitly requires them.
Use clear names, focused functions, explicit data contracts, separated concerns, and existing project conventions.
Prefer low-friction structured authoring commands for routine rule and requirement updates instead of manual JSON editing when the CLI can express the change safely.
